ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The mother's cry is in Serbian in the source, glossed in Russian in parentheses; the Serbian is kept in transliteration and only the gloss is translated. «Посредник» (Posrednik, 'The Intermediary') is the publishing house, kept by name; the source prints «5, 38 Матф.» (Matthew 5:38) for «не противься злому» (ne protivsya zlomu, 'do not resist evil'), which is Matthew 5:39, given here. Place names in the evident sense: «Тамешвар» (Tameshvar) is Temesvár and «Великая Кокинда» (Velikaya Kokinda) is Velika Kikinda; «Вечбас» (Vechbas) is kept as printed.
Source observation: [5] reference «(5, 38 Матф.)» for «А я говорю вам: не противься злому» ('But I say to you: do not resist evil'); the verse is Matthew 5:39; corrected in the English
Source observation: [7] «Вечбас» (Vechbas) in Bačka is unidentified, possibly a slip for Verbász (Vrbas, Russian «Вербас»); kept as printed
Source observation: [13] «Тамешвар» (Tameshvar) for Temesvár («Темешвар»); rendered Temesvár

Source observation: [13] the inner quotation «Люби ближнего, как самого себя. ('Love your neighbor as yourself.') has no closing guillemet; closed after «себя» in the English, since the following sentence is Novak's own
Source observation: [16] «Великая Кокинда» (Velikaya Kokinda) for Velika Kikinda (Nagykikinda); rendered Velika Kikinda
